normalized.result: Yes, that scope is exactly right and it's clear. In the architecture-only view, ticking "Select everything in this view" grabbed just those two visible architecture bookmarks — the phrase says "in this view," and that's precisely what it did, leaving everything else in my library untouched. That's the behaviour I'd want and expect: when I've filtered down to a label (or a search), "select everything" should mean everything *I'm currently looking at*, not secretly reach out and grab links I've filtered away. If it swept up hidden ones I couldn't see, that'd be alarming. So this is safe and predictable — bulk actions stay inside whatever I've narrowed to. Good.
